gaps.title: Missing Moodle SSO UI
gaps.jtbd: When I want to log into the archive, I want to use my Moodle account via SSO, so that I don't need separate credentials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated user on the login screen, When they choose to log in, Then they should see an option to authenticate via Moodle SSO.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires 'Единая сквозная аутентификация (SSO) через Moodle', but the frontend login page (index.html) uses a mock local login and has no UI or button to trigger the Moodle SSO flow.

gaps.title: Missing UI for Moodle Role Hierarchy Display
gaps.jtbd: When managing user access, I want to see and configure how Moodle roles map to archive roles, so that I can ensure correct access control.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an administrator, When they navigate to the settings or role management section, Then they should see the current mapping of Moodle roles to internal archive roles.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires 'отображение иерархии ролей Moodle в ролевую модель архива' (displaying Moodle role hierarchy), but the frontend has no interface to view or manage these mappings, despite backend endpoints existing.
